skills.name: client-report
skills.description: Generate professional client-facing performance reports with portfolio returns, allocation breakdowns, and market commentary. Suitable for quarterly or annual distribution. Triggers on "client report", "performance report", "quarterly report for [client]", "generate reports", or "client statement".
skills.description_zh: 生成面向客户的季度或年度投资表现报告，包含组合收益、配置分解及市场评论。

skills.name: client-review
skills.description: Prepare for client review meetings with portfolio performance summary, allocation analysis, talking points, and action items. Pulls together account data into a concise meeting-ready format. Use before quarterly reviews, annual checkups, or ad-hoc client meetings. Triggers on "client review", "meeting prep for [client]", "quarterly review", "prep for [client name]", or "client meeting".
skills.description_zh: 为季度、年度或临时客户评审会议汇总账户数据，形成组合表现、资产配置分析、讨论要点与行动项。

skills.name: investment-proposal
skills.description: Create professional investment proposals for prospective clients. Covers the firm's approach, proposed allocation, expected outcomes, and fee structure. Use when pitching new clients or presenting a new investment strategy. Triggers on "investment proposal", "prospect presentation", "pitch new client", "proposal for [client]", or "new client presentation".
skills.description_zh: 为潜在客户制作投资建议书，包含机构方法、建议资产配置、预期结果与收费结构，用于新客户推介或新策略展示。

skills.name: pptx-author
skills.description: Produce a .pptx file on disk (headless) instead of driving a live PowerPoint document — for managed-agent sessions with no open Office app.
skills.description_zh: 在没有打开 Office 应用的托管智能体环境中，以无界面方式直接生成磁盘上的 .pptx 文件。
